description: RZLT’s results for a given industry or need, e.g. industry "B2B SaaS", "maritime", "fintech", "AI"; need "launch", "pipeline", "developer signups", "SEO". Returns published case studies (with links) and, where they match, anonymous B2B results described in words. Leave both empty for the full list.

industry.description: The company’s industry or market, e.g. "maritime SaaS", "fintech", "consumer app".

need.description: What they want to achieve, e.g. "product launch", "more qualified leads", "show up in ChatGPT".
